item.title: Iran Says Strait Of Hormuz Will Not Reopen Until Conditions Are Met
item.description: The Strait of Hormuz will not reopen until seven Iranian conditions set out in a June interim agreement with the U.S. are met, Iran’s state media reported.
item.content:encoded: The Strait of Hormuz will not reopen until seven Iranian conditions set out in a June interim agreement with the U.S. are met, Iran’s state media reported.

item.title: Ax-Wielding FlyDubai Co-Pilot Had Been Flagged Over Extremism Concerns
item.description: The United Arab Emirates says the co-pilot on a FlyDubai flight that nearly crashed with 182 people on board attacked the captain with the cockpit’s crash ax in a “terrorist attack.”
